reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 161-170 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 36 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs were NOT opened. The FRDB snapshot /tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a, verified) was read with every column containing 'cmax' dropped before any row was printed. Arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex, population and application comments only. Original-source Cmax values were then read from original tables. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Full originals read: J-STAGE DMPK PDF (bisacodyl/sodium picosulfate), Europe PMC XML for PMC6138487 (elobixibat) and PMC3596677 (zaltoprofen), PMC scanned PDF for PMC1874307 (levormeloxifene; fetched via headless browser, transient file in gitignored .playwright-mcp/ deleted), PMDA review 000232054.pdf, Pharmacia open-access JATS XML (piribedil). Closed/blocked originals time-boxed to abstracts: Springer (romazarit), Elsevier (levormeloxifene Clin Ther, ONO-2952), Wiley/CPT (vesnarinone x2), J Pharm Sci (sulfameter), Taylor & Francis (biotin review, 403), Dustri (zaltoprofen BE, redirect loop). ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 checked for NCT01364441 (no results). Only PubMed E-utilities (MCP), Europe PMC, PMC, J-STAGE, PMDA, Pensoft, ClinicalTrials.gov API and publisher pages were queried. No email, contact identifier or Unpaywall was used; no repository file was modified.
unresolved_issues: Deacetylbisacodyl (1982): ineligible. FRDB row is total BHPM after 10 mg sodium picosulfate liquid (prodrug) in lactating women; neither dosed-parent nor free analyte.
Elobixibat (8024): all 4 arms ineligible - both BJCP and PMDA arms come from study AJG533/CP1 in Japanese chronic-constipation patients, not healthy adults.

Levormeloxifene (9627): 6 SAD arms verified_with_caveat (fasted oral solution with hydroxypropyl-β-cyclodextrin, healthy postmenopausal women); 2 age-group arms (11219480) unverified - Elsevier blocked.
Piribedil (6709): ineligible - prolonged-release tablet; Table 3 Cmax unit conflicts with text (ng/mL vs pg/mL) and n=15 vs 'twenty'.

Biotin (1161): unverified - secondary review source, endogenous baseline correction unknown, population/fasting unknown; recommend exclusion unless an original healthy fasted single-dose table is found.
Zaltoprofen (493): frdb_1269-1271 verified from open Table 3; frdb_1273/1274 (BE fasting capsule/tablet) unverified - Dustri full text inaccessible.
Vesnarinone (852), romazarit (3508), sulfameter (228), ONO-2952 (59570): all arms unverified - paywalled/blocked full texts, no Cmax in abstracts.

arms.reason: Mapped by AUCinf 209 ng·h/mL and t1/2 7.3 h, which match the SODIUM PICOSULFATE 10 mg column of Table 2 (bisacodyl column is AUC 471, t1/2 7.7). The dosed drug is the prodrug sodium picosulfate (20 drops Laxoberal liquid), not deacetylbisacodyl (BHPM); the analyte is TOTAL BHPM (glucuronidated + free active metabolite), not a dosed parent. Population is lactating women who had stopped breastfeeding, in a multiple-dose study; breakfast 1 h post-dose. Fails dosed-parent identity, analyte and population criteria. Value recorded for traceability only.
